[[File:501stlegion1.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Clone trooper/Legends|Members]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].]]
The '''501st Journal''' was a compiled record of journal entries written by one or more [[Retired clone trooper|retired members]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].

The entries summarized their most famous battles, captured the feelings of individual [[Stormtrooper/Legends|troopers]], and traced the 501st from its origins in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to its development as "[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader's]] Fist" during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The journal was kept as secret as the missions undertaken by the 501st; only after the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] were the journals recovered.

The battles recorded included:

==[[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]==
===[[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] "''Attack of the Clones"''===
<blockquote>''"My first day as a member of the 501st... it was hot, it was sandy, chaotic. Nothing at all like the simulations on Kamino. Of course, that's pretty much the way it was for all of us, wasn't it? All that breeding, all those years of training... it doesn't really prepare you for all the screaming or the blood, does it? Frankly, I'm still amazed we ever made it through the first hour, never mind the first day."''</blockquote><blockquote>''"Incredibly, the 501st survived the crucible of Geonosis, emerging battle-hardened, and ready for whatever the war would throw at us."''</blockquote>

===[[Battle of Mygeeto]] "''Amongst the Ruins"''===
<blockquote>''"In the waning months of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the 501st faced missions critical to the agenda of [[Palpatine/Legends|Chancellor Palpatine]]. When we arrived at the bombed out ruins of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], our [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] commander believed we had been sent to take out a droid [[energy collector]]. What [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] didn't know however was that our unit of the 501st was really after an experimental [[Energy crystal|Mygeetan power source]], that the Chancellor wanted for his [[Hammertong/Legends|superlaser]]. Keeping Mundi in the dark wasn't easy; the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had become increasingly wary of the Chancellor's doings, and were on the lookout for the slightest hint of treachery. Just like the rest of them though, he never caught whiff of what was really going on, until it was far too late."''</blockquote><blockquote>''"The success of the mission on Mygeeto was something of a revelation for the men of the 501st. Suddenly, we realized that the Jedi could be fooled. And if they could be fooled, they could be killed."''</blockquote>

===[[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] [Space] "''A Desperate Rescue"''===
<blockquote>''"As the Clone Wars progressed, more and more ground-based legions found themselves pressed into space combat, including the fighting forces of the 501st. For months, every hour of our downtime was spent in the [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulator]], preparing for the time we would face our enemies from the cockpit of a [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|170]]. Finally the day came to earn our wings. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] had staged a daring kidnapping of Chancellor Palpatine, and was being escorted from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by a fleet of Separatist ships. With only a few veteran pilots on-planet, many of the 501st were pressed into service to drive off the Seps, and buy time for a pair of Jedi Knights to rescue the Chancellor."''</blockquote><blockquote>''"After disabling the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|final capital ship]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] took advantage of the opportunity we'd created and rescued the Chancellor. Took all the credit, too."''</blockquote>

===[[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]] "''Heart of Darkness"''===
<blockquote>''"It's been said that the 501st got the best of the war. We also got the worst. On [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], the Seps dug their metal heels into the muck of that alien hellhole and dared the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to come in after them. So we did, only to be met with month after month of flesh-eating diseases, shrieking nocturnal predators, and other sights that haunt me to this day. Cut off and for all we knew abandoned by our superiors, our only hope was [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], our Jedi commander. Without her iron will, none of us would have come out of that mess with our sanity, or our lives. When her death came, I hope it was quick. She earned that much."''</blockquote><blockquote>''"When the 501st was finally rotated out of Felucia, Aayla Secura made a point of seeing us off personally, calling us the bravest soldiers she had ever seen. It's a good thing we were wearing helmets, because none of us could bear to look her in the eye."''</blockquote>

===Battle of Kashyyyk [Space] "''First Line of Defense"''===
<blockquote>"''When the Separatists' invasion of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] caught the Republic flatfooted, a detachment of the 501st was sent in to stop the bleeding until reinforcements could arrive. It was a textbook suicide mission and we knew it. As we fought our way into Kashyyyk's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], most of us believed that the only way we'd be getting off this planet was in a [[Body bag/Legends|body bag]]."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''As the 501st finally broke through the Sep [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] over Kashyyyk, I took a long look back at the battle that continued to rage over the planet, and wondered why so many had to die for a bunch of [[Wookiee/Legends|walking carpets]]. Then I followed my orders, and turned planetward."''</blockquote>

===[[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] "''A Line in the Sand"''===
<blockquote>"''When we arrived on Kashyyyk, things were just as bad as we'd feared. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had us outgunned, outmaneuvered, and outmanned by a five-to-one margin. What none of us had counted on was the Wookiees. We'd all heard the stories, of course, but we'd never fought next to them, never seen them rip apart a droid with their bare hands. They were magnificent. Even so it was still a suicide mission, at least it was until [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived. Then it became a battle; a winnable battle."..''</blockquote><blockquote>"''With the timely arrival of Master Yoda, the 501st were able to hold the line against the Seps on Kashyyyk. We left as heroes. Years later, we'd return as conquerors."''</blockquote>

===[[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]] "''Underground Ambush''"===
<blockquote>"''In our bones, we knew the war was almost over. [[The galaxy/Legends|The Galaxy]] held its breath, waiting to see which side would make the final daring move. As fortune would have it, the Republic moved first. After the Chancellor informed the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] that [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]] and the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Sep leaders]] were hiding on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], General Kenobi gathered an army large enough to capture three star systems. When the orders reached the 501st, our morale soared. For better or worse, this would be the beginning of the end."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''With the death of General Grievous at the hands of General Kenobi, the Utapau raid had broken the back of the Separatists. Under normal circumstances, it would have been a time for celebration. But our next orders put paid to those thoughts."''</blockquote>

===[[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] "''Knightfall''"===
<blockquote>"''What I remember about the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] is... is how quiet it was. During the waning hours of the Clone Wars, the 501st Legion was discreetly transferred back to Coruscant. It was a silent trip. We all knew what was about to happen, what we were about to do. Did we have any doubts? Any private, traitorous thoughts? Perhaps, but no one said a word. Not on the flight to Coruscant, not when Order 66 came down, and not when we marched into the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Not a word."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''With the fall of Coruscant and the elimination of the traitorous Jedi, Palpatine's rise to power was complete. In recognition of our service and loyalty to the Emperor, the 501st were placed under the direct command of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]]. Armed with deadly new weapons, blazing new ships, and shiny new armor, our presence let the galaxy know that the days of the Old Republic were well and truly over. We were establishing a new era, an era of order and peace."''</blockquote>

==[[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]==
===[[Battle of Naboo (Imperial Period)|Raid on Naboo]] "''Imperial Diplomacy''"===
<blockquote>"''During the rise of the Empire, the Emperor's home planet of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] rapidly established itself as a major irritant. After a number of Naboo's [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] were sent home in various states of dismemberment, her newly elected [[Apailana/Legends|Queen]] broke off diplomatic ties, and began exploring military options. Clearly it was time for a regime change, a change that would be effected by the 501st, now under the direct command of Darth Vader. Our orders were simple: to infiltrate the city, take out their leader, sending a clear signal to other potential troublemakers in the Empire."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''With the Queen eliminated, Naboo quickly fell in line. It was the first time the 501st was called upon to "adjust" a planet's government, but it wouldn't be the last. Within months, the 501st gained a well-deserved reputation as "[[501st Legion/Legends|Vader's Fist]].""''</blockquote>

===[[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|Battle of Mustafar]] [Space] "''Preventive Measures''"===
<blockquote>"''Although the Clone Wars were over, some people never seemed to get the message. The worst case of denial was [[Gizor Dellso]], a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] Separatist who'd somehow escaped Lord Vader's efforts to wipe out the remnants of the CIS. Lord Vader tracked him to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], and brought us in to finish the job. It seemed like a simple enough mission, but when we saw the [[Gizor Dellso's navy|fleet of droid ships]], hovering over the planet, we suddenly realized that Dellso's denial mechanisms were a little more dangerous than we'd imagined."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''The slight whiff of nostalgia the 501st had enjoyed fighting the droid fleet over Mustafar had already grown sour by the time we'd established orbital positions. Now it was time to find out what this was all about."''</blockquote>

===[[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|Battle of Mustafar]] "''Tying up Loose Ends''"===
<blockquote>"''By the time we'd made our way to the molten surface of Mustafar, it was apparent that Dellso had been a busy little bug. All by his lonesome, he'd found a previously [[Techno Union droid factory/Legends|hidden droid factory]], fired it up and cranked out his own private army of battle droids. Needless to say, this got the men of the 501st...a little hot under the helmet, and not just because of all that lava. Truth be told we'd all had our fill of those gear heads during the war, and we couldn't stomach the thought of going through another one. So we blew them up. Blew up the droids, blew up the factory, damn near blew up the planet."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''The destruction of the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|mining facility]] put an end to any thoughts of a second droid rebellion. For the first time in years, the men of the 501st could relax, and get about the business of maintaining an Empire, rather than building one."''</blockquote>

===[[Kamino uprising|Kamino Uprising]] "''Changing of the Guard''"===
<blockquote>"O''fficially, there never was a [[Kamino uprising|clone rebellion]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Unofficially, approximately twenty years after we were created, a special detachment of the Imperial 501st Legion was dispatched to Kamino, with orders to eradicate an [[Anti-trooper|army of clones]] that had been bred to take arms against the Empire. Our mission commander, an expert on the inner workings of Kamino, was a young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''The bounty hunter left after the battle was over. He said something about tracking down a [[Han Solo/Legends|smuggler]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After the Kamino uprising, the Emperor decided that an army of genetically identical soldiers was too susceptible to corruption. Future troopers would be cloned from a variety of templates. Though the 501st itself remained pure, the rest of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] gradually became more and more diverse. We never really got used to the new guys."''</blockquote>

==[[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]==
===[[Death Star Uprising]] "''Prison Break''"===
<blockquote>"''Once it was finally finished, the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] was the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] favorite toy. It was also the most boring assignment in the galaxy for a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]. Tedious inspection drills, endless hours of guarding impregnable [[Force-field generator|force field generators]]. Things got so bad that when a prison break erupted in the cell block, we were almost happy to have someone shooting at us again. If only we had known what an embarrassing snipestorm we were about to wade into, we probably would have jettisoned the whole [[Detention area|detention block]] into space."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''After the embarrassment of the prison break, Lord Vader removed us from our comfortable billet, and began dragging the 501st across the galaxy, in a dangerous hunt for the now missing [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]]. Ironically, our punishment eventually proved to be our salvation. The poor souls who took our place in the detention area were completely wiped out when the Death Star was destroyed."''</blockquote>

===[[Raid on Polis Massa]] "''Birth of the Rebellion''"===
<blockquote>"''By the time of the raid on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]], the men of the 501st were starting to get a little sick of this so called "[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]." In the past, we'd secretly enjoyed putting down a local insurrection or two. They kept the troops sharp and the Empire feared, but these Rebels were different. They were organized, they were growing, and they were everywhere. The raid on Polis Massa was a perfect example of how things were starting to fall apart. We were supposed to go in, wipe out a small band of Rebels, and recover some stolen Imperial plans on an encrypted [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisk]]. Before we knew it, we were nearly overrun by Rebel forces, with the holodisk nowhere to be found."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''Even though the Polis Massa raid was only a partial success, we finally had a lead on the whereabouts of the Death Star plans, which suited the 501st just fine."''</blockquote>

===[[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Battle on the Tantive IV]] "''Recovering the Plans''"===
<blockquote>"''With the information gathered on Polis Massa, Vader concluded that the stolen plans had been given to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. We weren't surprised. For all their talk of being a peaceful planet, Alderaan had been thumbing its nose at the Empire for years. After a brief and pointless battle, we boarded the ship, the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], over Tatooine, began looking for the plans, and waited for Lord Vader's arrival."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''After Lord Vader took custody of Princess Leia, we all figured it was just a matter of time before she coughed up the plans. Many of us had been unwilling witnesses to Vader's powers of persuasion in the past. The thought of a pampered little princess resisting his terrible will was inconceivable."''</blockquote>

===[[Strike on Yavin 4]] [Space] "''Vader's Fist Strikes Back''"===
<blockquote>"''When the Death Star was destroyed, about half of the 501st Legion was still in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] getting to their ships. Of those who made it out, another third were caught in the explosion. I'd fought with some of those men for over twenty years. Afterwards, those of us that survived hooked up with a nearby [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]] making a retaliatory strike on the [[Rebel base|Rebels' base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]]. It wasn't the best thought out plan, but we were cut off from our leaders, tired, and operating on instinct. If not for our training, we probably would've never gotten past their orbital defenses."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''And so the battle over Yavin came to an end. I'm told we destroyed hundreds of Rebel ships that day. Even if it had been thousands, it wouldn't have made up for the Death Star."''</blockquote>

===Strike on Yavin 4 ''"Revenge of the Empire"''===
<blockquote>"''By the time we landed on Yavin, whatever shock we'd felt at the destruction of the Death Star had been replaced by anger. For months we'd treated the Rebellion like a disobedient child, only to be repaid for our tolerance with treachery on an unimaginable scale. Frankly, I don't remember much of the fighting. I guess we won."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''After the battle, the surviving members of the 501st finally caught their breath. The Empire had taken the Rebels' best shot and come up standing. Now it was our turn to strike."''</blockquote>

===[[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] "''Our Finest Hour''"===
<blockquote>"''No one ever complained about the cold on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. We never felt it. Even though we were blinded by blizzards, we could see the final end of the Rebellion in our [[Blaster sight/Legends|blaster sights]]. Was it only a mirage? Perhaps. But on that day, on that planet, our blood ran hot with dreams of victory, melting the ice that stood in our way."''</blockquote><blockquote>"''As the Rebels fled, the 501st gathered around a burning bunker and let out a cheer that shook the stars. The Rebellion was done, the Death Star was being rebuilt, bigger than ever. Order had finally returned to the Galaxy, in no small part due to the efforts of the fighting men of the 501st."''</blockquote>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Temuera Morrison]] provides the voice for the narrator of every journal entry. In the game's credits, the character is identified simply as "[[Retired clone trooper]]," implying that he survived all of the battles above mentioned.
